source.time_basis: frame_index / 25, relative to first decoded video frame

preprocessing: none: full original decoded 4096x1080 RGB frames; no masks, crops, resizing or drawn boxes in training inputs

class_policy.player: Identifiable active players, both teams and goalkeepers.
class_policy.ball: Visually recognizable footballs including reserve balls; no inferred hidden ball.
class_policy.other_person: Other individually recognizable people and people whose exact role is unclear; no guessed steward or spectator identity.
class_policy.crowd: One group box for a dense or occluded bench/steps group; not a claimed count of individual people. Individual members are not also labelled as other_person.
class_policy.goal: A recognizable separate physical goal frame and net, including training goals. Painted goal outlines are not physical goals.
class_policy.corner_flag: Corner-flag pole and visible flag, not nearby cones or slalom poles.
class_policy.stored_goals: An overlapping pile of stored goals whose individual outlines cannot be reliably separated; group entity, not one ordinary goal.
